title: Scalar and localized extension commute by normalized adjunctions
statement: Let C have Grothendieck topology J and let a:A→S be a unital morphism of commutative ring sheaves, with module sheafification and its locally bijective characterization in a common universe on J and J/U. For each A|_U-module G there is an S-linear isomorphism S tensor_A j_A!G ≅ j_S!(S|_U tensor_(A|_U) G), sending b tensor [x]_f to [b tensor x]_f for every original summand f:W→U. Moreover for any S-module N, two maps from S tensor_A j_A!G to N are equal if they agree on all 1 tensor [x]_f. The latter assertion only requires sheafification on J. Unlike [lem-sf-slice-scalar-level-comparison], this has no coefficient tower, presentation transports, scalar-restriction identification or transition and module-map coherence assertions.

proof.text: Construct the sectionwise scalar extension/restriction Hom equivalence. Naturality follows on 1 tensor x from the presheaf morphism equation. Compose it with the module sheafification adjunction. The transpose evaluates on the sheafification image of 1 tensor x.

proof.text: Compose this normalized coefficient Hom equivalence with localized extension adjunction in both orders. Restricting scalars and restricting to the slice commute definitionally, so the two results are maps from G to (Res N)|_U. Evaluation on original summands identifies the transposes. Equality on unit tensors gives equal transposes and hence the Hom extensionality assertion.

proof.text: The resulting Hom equivalence is natural in N, as evaluation on unit tensors shows. Apply its two directions to identity maps; naturality proves the inverse identities. Evaluation gives the generator formula for coefficient 1. Linearity of both the comparison and the sheafified summand insertion gives the formula for every b.
